newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan May domestic output up 18.3% yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Nissan May domestic output up 18.3% yr/yr.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd said on Friday its domestic vehicle production rose 18.3 percent from a year earlier to 140,435 vehicles in May.
Nissan's May exports rose 29.8 percent year-on-year to 52,158 vehicles.
Its domestic sales fell 13.5 percent from a year earlier to 59,791 units.
Nissan's May domestic production rose for a fifth successive month on a year-on-year basis.
Its vehicle exports rose for the ninth straight month due to higher exports to Asia, Oceania, the Middle East, and North America.
Its domestic sales fell for the second straight month.
Nissan's overseas production fell for the first time in 11 months, reflecting lower production at its U.S. unit ahead of the start-up of production of the remodelled Altima model in July.
